subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should authenticated hook callers be allowed to synchronously receive agent output from `POST /hooks/agent`, and what result, error, timeout, replay, and audit contract should that public API support?
rationale: Source inspection proves the feature gap, but cleanup automation cannot safely choose whether raw assistant output over hook auth, a hardened envelope, or a narrower result-reference design is the intended security boundary.

options.title: Adopt With Hardening
options.body: Use the linked `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` shape on the existing endpoint, with explicit limits, redaction, timeout, replay, and failure-audit behavior chosen before merge.

options.title: Choose A Narrower Contract
options.body: Redirect the implementation to a dedicated sync endpoint, bounded envelope, or short-lived `resultRef` if raw synchronous output is too broad for hook auth.

options.title: Decline Core Support
options.body: Keep the documented async hook plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked implementation if maintainers decide this should remain downstream-specific.

recommendation.title: Adopt With Hardening
recommendation.body: Use the linked `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` shape on the existing endpoint, with explicit limits, redaction, timeout, replay, and failure-audit behavior chosen before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans gateway HTTP API shape, hook endpoint ownership, and security posture, and this handle has the strongest history on the current endpoint structure plus direct discussion routing.
